01 / About us

Built in Hyderabad. Rooted in Tirupati.

Since 1994, Mr. Konduri Mahesh has been in construction at Hyderabad, completing nearly 150 individual residential projects, with a background in financing.

In 2015 he formed Vasavi Media Tone Enterprises with family members. The firm became the exclusive pan-India distributor of Silk Plaster and executes civil and structural contract works. Kanyaka Infra Private Limited was incorporated on 30 August 2023 to expand these activities.

Company Kanyaka Infra Private Limited CIN U74102AP2023PTC112189 · Registered office: Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh

Meet the board →

Vision

To develop and build projects in Tirupati and Hyderabad that owners, investors and the city can rely on for decades.

Mission

To deliver every project to its agreed scope, specification and schedule, and to keep transparent dealings with clients, investors, landowners and partners.

Specifications

As per the construction contract signed with the society on 22 September 2025.

Civil work
Walls in approved bricks/blocks. Internal plaster: single coat, 10 mm, 1:5 cement mortar with PPC 43-grade cement and river sand. 9-inch external walls in cement blocks, finished with 6 mm Bison panelling or single-coat 1:4 M-sand cement plaster. Cement: UltraTech or Zuari.
Electrical
Sudhakar conduits; Legrand metal boxes, boards, DB and modular switches; Polycab or Finolex wiring; 25 A, 15 A and 10 A MCB circuits per flat. Points include AC and room-heater points in the hall and bedrooms, three 16 A kitchen points for oven, chimney and dishwasher, geyser and exhaust points in bathrooms, washing-machine and dishwasher points in the utility, and stainless-steel cradle hooks in the hall and balcony.
Plumbing & sanitary
CPVC pipes: 1-inch supply, ¾-inch delivery and hot water; SW pipes for flush-out (4-inch) and drainage (6-inch); 2-inch PVC grey-water lines; Sudhakar or Ashirvad. Cera CP fittings (brass with stainless-steel coating), Cera wall-mounted WCs and wash basins, including a dining-area basin; 24 × 18 inch stainless-steel kitchen sink with purifier and future GHMC water points; diverters, health faucets and geyser points in toilets; individual stop valves in each bathroom and a master stop valve for each flat.
Painting
Double-coat putty with clear primer on internal walls (Birla or Asian Paints); two coats of Asian Paints Tractor Emulsion inside and Asian Paints Ace Exterior Emulsion outside over a primer coat.
Railings
Balconies: Jindal 316-grade, 16-gauge stainless steel with 12 mm toughened glass. Staircase: 1.6 mm, 202-grade stainless steel, 4 ft high, with 6 mm glass, three intermediate pipes and posts at every two steps.
Flooring & tiling
12 mm high-gloss vitrified/PGVT tiles, 60 × 60 cm, with 10 cm skirting and spacer joints (Kajaria). Kitchen: Z-black granite platform, its height set to accommodate a dishwasher, with wall tiles up to 4 ft above it. Bathrooms: 30 × 30 cm anti-skid floor tiles and 45 × 30 cm wall tiles up to 7 ft, epoxy-grouted (Kajaria). Utility: 30 × 30 cm anti-skid tiles. Corridors: PEI-5 anti-skid wood-finish tiles, wall tiles up to at least 5 ft and granite tops on short walls; staircase in steel-grey granite.
Doors
Main door 7 × 4 ft with granite frame, 35 mm flush shutter with 4 mm teak veneer and Godrej hardware. Bedroom doors 3 × 7 ft with granite frames, 30 mm laminated shutters and Godrej locks. Toilet and utility doors 2 ft 9 in × 7 ft in 28 mm WPC. Brand: Century Ply or GreenPlast.
Windows
UPVC 95-series sliding windows (Fenesta or equivalent), 4 × 4.5 ft, with 5 mm toughened glass and mosquito mesh; 3-track UPVC sliding doors with two glass panels and one mesh panel.
Fire safety
Automatic fire detection and alarm, sprinklers, water supply and fire pumps as per the National Building Code for high-rise buildings.
Common services
Two 25,000-litre overhead tanks, two 20,000-litre sumps, rainwater harvesting, cellar levelling with parking tiles for two-wheelers and common-area lighting; RCC water-tank walls 9 inches thick.
Additional works
Electrical transformer; mineral water plant; two elevators of 950 kg (2,100 lb), one a service lift, Schindler or OTIS, with granite cladding; a Schindler elevator for the amenities block; generator; pressure pump; fire equipment; three 6-inch borewells; Bison-panel shelf slabs. Common-area plumbing, electrical and other builder works maintenance-free for two years.
Parking & club house
A four-floor, 36,000 sq ft block: two parking floors of 10,000 sq ft with 112 parking spaces and a 40 ft wide driveway from the access road, and club-house floors of 8,000 sq ft with Carrier split air-conditioning of about 20 TR. Automatic glass entrance, lounge and reception, a two-floor air-conditioned amphitheatre, gym, restaurant, indoor play area, grocery and salon.
Open areas
About one acre of landscaping with drainage, walkways, a children’s play area and gardens; visitors’ parking of at least 1,000 sq ft with three EV charging stations; swimming pool with chlorination and filtration; two 40,000-litre overhead tanks.

The Saptara · architectural visualisation

/ The project

Reimagined for Tirupati. Ready to rise.

Following its request for proposals, Tirupati Smart City Corporation Limited (TSCCL) issued the work order to Kanyaka Infra Private Limited in August 2026 to develop the multi-level building opposite Tirupati Railway Station into an integrated multiplex, commercial and hospitality destination of a basement and seven upper floors.

The project is a public–private partnership on a Design, Build, Finance, Operate and Transfer (DBFOT) basis, with a 33-year concession that includes a two-year construction period, on a revenue-sharing basis. Bid in association with Vasavi Media Tone Enterprises, it is ready to start construction.

Concession authority Tirupati Smart City Corporation Limited PPP · DBFOT · 33 years including 2 years of construction
The name Sapta + Tara: seven + star For the Seven Hills and seven-star experiences: shop, dine, work, stay, relax, celebrate and live. Guests are our stars.

01 / The board

Three decades of execution.

The board of Kanyaka Infra Private Limited and the group firm behind its distribution and contract work.

Promoter & Managing Director

Konduri Mahesh

PG in Industrial Relations & Personnel Management, Osmania University (Gold Medalist)

Mr. Konduri Mahesh has worked in construction at Hyderabad since 1994, completing nearly 150 individual residential projects, and has a background in financing. In 2003 he started Sri Vari Sannidhi, a pilgrim accommodation project at Tirupati. In 2015 he formed Vasavi Media Tone Enterprises with family members, which became the official pan-India distributor of Silk Plaster, an eco-friendly decorative wall covering. He incorporated Kanyaka Infra Private Limited to expand the promoter group’s three-decade construction work.

  • Chairman, Construction Committee, Sri Kanyaka Parameswari Devasthanam
  • Convener, Sri Kanyaka Parameswari Devasthanam
  • Secretary, Smt Panguluri Seethamma Gari Arya Vysya Dharma Sathram
30+years in construction Nearly150residential projects 250+investors onboarded
Managing Director’s message

I began working in construction in Hyderabad in 1994. Since then our work has covered individual homes, apartments, guest houses, commercial buildings and a temple reconstruction, and more than 250 investors have placed their trust in our projects. Our tagline, Business nahin rishtey banathe, describes how we intend to keep working: every project is a commitment to the people who invest in it, live in it and build it with us. Kanyaka Infra Private Limited carries this experience into larger assignments, including The Saptara with Tirupati Smart City Corporation Limited. We will continue to build to the agreed specification, report progress openly and complete what we start.

Konduri Mahesh, Managing Director
